exposure: risk factors for Gestational Diabetes Mellitus
history of macrossomic newborn (birth weight > 4000 g)
first-degree relatives with Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus
finding: Pregnant women with GDM risk factors had more obstetric interventions and their infants experienced higher rates of complications compared to women without risk factors.
mod_finding: Pregnant women with risk factors for gestational diabetes who were treated for the condition were more likely to have a cesarean section compared to women without risk factors who were treated for gestational diabetes.
